description: This file defines an abstract class 'BaseNoteFragment' for an Android application, which manages note editing functionalities such as loading, saving, categorizing, sharing, and pinning notes within the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It includes lifecycle management, menu handling, and interaction with repositories and external components.

classes.name: BaseNoteFragment
classes.description: An abstract fragment class providing core functionalities for note editing, including loading, saving, categorizing, sharing, pinning, and lifecycle management within the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and sets up the listener and repository.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Handles view creation, initializes account, loads note data, and updates UI.

methods.name: initializeAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the current account via SingleAccountHelper and repository.

methods.name: loadFromSavedState
methods.description: Restores note and original note from saved instance state.

methods.name: loadFromArguments
methods.description: Loads note based on provided arguments, either existing or new.

methods.name: loadExistingNote
methods.description: Loads an existing note by ID, possibly switching accounts.

methods.name: createNewNote
methods.description: Creates a new note from parameters or content.

methods.name: getScrollView
methods.description: Abstract method to get the ScrollView component.

methods.name: scrollToY
methods.description: Abstract method to scroll to a specific Y position.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates the note in the listener when resuming.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Saves the note state when pausing.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Clears the listener reference.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves note state for configuration changes.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates menu and adds pin shortcut option if supported.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares menu items based on note state and preferences.

methods.name: prepareFavoriteOption
methods.description: Sets icon and appearance for favorite menu item.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item actions such as delete, favorite, category, move, share, and pin.

methods.name: pinNoteToHome
methods.description: Creates a shortcut pinning the note to the home screen if supported.

methods.name: shareNote
methods.description: Shares the note content via Android share dialog.

methods.name: onNoteLoaded
methods.description: Initializes scroll position and sets scroll listener.

methods.name: onScroll
methods.description: Callback for scroll events, can be overridden.

methods.name: shouldShowToolbar
methods.description: Determines if the toolbar should be visible.

methods.name: onCloseNote
methods.description: Deletes the note if unchanged and not modified.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Saves current note content and scroll position, schedules sync.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Abstract method to get the current note content.

methods.name: showCategorySelector
methods.description: Displays category selection dialog.

methods.name: showEditTitleDialog
methods.description: Displays dialog to edit note title.

methods.name: onCategoryChosen
methods.description: Callback when a category is selected, updates note.

methods.name: onTitleEdited
methods.description: Callback when title is edited, updates note asynchronously.

methods.name: moveNote
methods.description: Moves note to another account.
